name: images_resize
description: Resize to exact pixels (no AI). For real detail upscaling: `images_upscale` first. Aspect: `images_crop`. Center-crop on aspect mismatch; keeps the source format.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
